title: Lead Infrastructure Engineer (DevOps)
description:
We are looking for a skilled
 **Lead Infrastructure Engineer** 
 to join our Technology team at Clarivate. In this role, you will administer, automate, and troubleshoot large\-scale Linux and Kubernetes environments while contributing to infrastructure reliability, operational tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and production incident resolution.
   

  

 You will work in a complex production environment and collaborate with engineering, DevOps, security, networking, storage, and operations teams to deliver scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure solutions.
   

  

**About You – Experience, Education, Skills, And Accomplishments**
* 6 Years of strong experience administering Linux/Unix environments (RHEL, CentOS, Oracle Linux).
* Hands\-on expertise with Python and Bash scripting for automation and operational tooling.
* Experience managing and troubleshooting production Kubernetes and container platforms.
* Strong knowledge of CI/CD tools and practices, including Jenkins, GitHub, and GitLab.
* Understanding of networking, security, storage, compute, and infrastructure architecture.
* Proven experience in incident management, root cause analysis, and production troubleshooting.


**It Would Be Great If You Also Had**
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Ansible and Terraform.
* Strong understanding of Git workflows, branching strategies, and version control best practices.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK.
* Knowledge of virtualization technologies including VMware vSphere and KVM.
* Experience with HashiCorp Vault and enterprise secrets management practices.
* Exposure to large\-scale, highly available, enterprise production environments.


**What You Will Be Doing In This Role**
* Administer, maintain, and troubleshoot Linux systems across production environments.
* Develop automation solutions using Python and Bash to improve operational efficiency.
* Manage Kubernetes clusters, container platforms, and application deployments.
* Design, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines and release automation processes.
* Lead production incident resolution, root cause analysis, and service recovery activities.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to enhance infrastructure reliability, scalability, and security.


 At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non\-discrimination in all locations.

title: Snowflake administrator/DevOps Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
**WNS, part of Capgemini,** 
 is an Agentic AI\-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI\-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.
   

  

 Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human\-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
 We promise our employees to experience
 **role clarity, coaching and mentoring, professional development and structured career path through our 5 people promises** 
 and keeping employee experience at the core. Experience the culture of Outperformance, engagement, celebration and enjoy wide variety of
 **best in class benefits including free HMO coverage for self and dependent from Day 1** 
 ; Also contribute to society through our
 **WNS Cares Foundation** 
 , where you have the opportunity to support meaningful initiatives and make an impact in the community.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Job Description**
 Design and administer Snowflake databases, schemas, roles, warehouses and access controls for Knowledge Domains.
   

  

 Automate provisioning, configuration and promotion through Infrastructure\-as\-Code and CI/CD.
   

  

 Apply naming, security, governance, tagging and lifecycle standards.
   

  

 Provide expert support, troubleshooting and guidance on Snowflake features.
   

  

 Improve monitoring, performance, reliability and cost visibility.
   

  

 Deliverables
   

  

 Reusable target structure and naming standard for Knowledge Domains.
   

  

 Automated provisioning templates and Terraform modules for databases, schemas, roles, warehouses, grants and tags.
   

  

 CI/CD pipelines with validation, approval, deployment and rollback controls.
   

  

 Role\-based access\-control matrix and implemented governance rules.
   

  

 Monitoring and alerting for usage, failures, performance, security and credit consumption.
   

  

 Operational runbooks for onboarding, deployment, support, incident handling and recovery.
   

  

 Snowflake feature\-support backlog, resolved technical requests and concise knowledge\-base articles.
   

  

 Technical handover documentation and knowledge\-transfer sessions.
   

  

**Skills And Experience**
 5\+ years in Snowflake administration, data platform or DevOps engineering.
   

  

 Strong Snowflake, SQL, RBAC, performance and cost\-management experience.
   

  

 Hands\-on Terraform, Git and CI/CD automation skills; Python or scripting is desirable.
   

  

 Experience with cloud data platforms, observability, security and production support.
   

  

 Soft skills
   

  

 Problem solving and delivery focus.
   

  

 Clear professional English and concise documentation.
   

  

 Cross\-team collaboration and ability to work autonomously.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Graduate/Post Graduate
